data.title: 焰影苇草 · 带回来的面包
data.description: 她把刚买的面包放到桌上，切好后用布盖住，等大家到齐再一起吃。
data.promptProse: In a cozy sunlit kitchen, Reed places a freshly baked round artisanal loaf onto an oiled wooden cutting board. A checkered linen cloth, an earthen bread crock, and a steaming kettle on the hearth add warmth to the rustic morning scene.
data.animaCaption: Covering the sliced crusty loaf with a clean linen cloth, she sets the bread basket in the center of the sunlit table with a tranquil smile.
